title: Pondering Pufflepout
statement: A slow, round little fish with enormous droopy eyes and a permanent look of gentle concern, the Pufflepout spends its days drifting between soft green fronds, pausing occasionally to stare at nothing in particular with great seriousness. Its tank is a hushed, green-gold world of dappled light and patience, best appreciated by those willing to slow down and wonder what it's thinking.
